months.details: Kick-off month. W1 (Mon 5 Oct) opens with the MoU signing week: legal mark-up, NDA and approvals pack are closed and the MoU is negotiated and signed by ODA and AIREV in the Thu 8 – Sat 10 Oct signing window (G1), which authorises the build work — every later date is indicative pending that signature. The build starts immediately: technical discovery of the ODA estate, dev/staging/prod environments and CI/CD (W1–W2), sovereign-tenant design and provisioning for UAE North (W1–W4), subscription-agreement/DPA/seat-schedule templates (W1–W4) and the product-hardening standard (W1–W3). Wave-1 is frozen at 16 products with 8 targeted for go-live and hardening of the 4 Strategy products begins W2; anchor seat blocks (~500, UAE-only base case) are confirmed and sponsors named by W2; the Dalberg programme office and Abu Dhabi HQ stand up. From W2–W3 the legal form & jurisdiction and shareholders’ agreement, the Athar Reason / Swift model pools and request router, Entra ID SAML SSO and seat provisioning, data-residency terms and the anchor DPA pack, re-pointing of the 25+ public-data connectors, the per-entity IT & security review packs, the training curriculum and the M&E framework all get under way and anchor term sheets (heads of terms) go out to the five entities; W4 (26 Oct) adds incorporation paperwork, the security baseline (Sentinel audit, secrets, pen test), the platform licence and hardening of the 4 H&DI products. The weekly delivery / fortnightly steering cadence begins and runs through W26.

months.details: G2 month. Entra ID SAML SSO with seat provisioning goes live and the Athar Reason / Swift model pools and request router are in place by W5 (6 Nov); the legal form, jurisdiction and shareholders’ agreement are settled the same week, and the data-residency terms and anchor DPA pack close W6. On Fri 20 Nov (W7) the sovereign platform is certified ready and the venture is incorporated — trade licence, bank account and tax registration — with the 25+ public-data connectors re-pointed to the venture repo and the security baseline (Sentinel audit, secrets, pen test) complete: that is G2, the SIGN & FORMALISE gate. The first JV Board meets on 27 Nov (W8) with the board constitution, reserved matters and wave-gate charter in place; the 4 Strategy Wave-1 products are hardened, the platform licence (incl. expansion schedule) is executed and the Wave-1 licensed data subscriptions are procured. W5 (2 Nov) starts the ~50-skill catalogue migration, the Wave-2 build for Programme Design & Grants and Investment & DF, data-scout & deep-research depth work and the procurement of Wave-1 licensed data subscriptions, and W6 adds the Wave-2 M&E build (Heatmap, Synthesiser, Bridge); hardening of the 4 H&DI products, the per-entity IT & security review packs and the 100-user training programme continue. Benchmark & substance gates (W7–W9), BYOI/BYOC/BYOH air-gapped patterns and open-source repo separation (from W7) and end-to-end UAT with 15–20 ODA users (W8–W10) start; anchor heads-of-terms negotiation runs toward W9, and W9 (30 Nov) opens the ADQ MSA / Core42 MSA extension work and anchor procurement through each entity’s cycle.
